verdict.rationale: Nix has no GUI to reach parity with. Its documented interface is an official CLI (nix build, develop, run, search, flake, repl, bundle) plus declarative Nix expressions and configuration.nix. That means core operations (install, upgrade, rollback, build, environments, system config) are scriptable and programmatic by design. However, there is no documented HTTP/programmatic API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so 'API' parity rests on CLI and config-as-code rather than a formal API. Missing for 10: a documented programmatic API (HTTP/OpenAPI or SDK), explicit documentation of interface coverage/parity, and independent evidence of agent-driven use.
